reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is the user-provided parameter 'param' which reaches the HTML response after being encoded by ESAPI.encoder().encodeForHTML(), but the XSS vulnerability exists because the data flows through the unencoded SQL query string before encoding. Alert 2 (java/sql-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink value is 'param' which directly concatenates into the SQL string, making it vulnerable to injection. Both alerts are exploitable on their respective paths.
